cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The club money's in the other envelope. Let's tell everyone they can stop worrying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You phoned me crying that the treasurer had stolen it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And you're the first person I'm reassuring. Could you pass on that it's all accounted for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told the whole committee what you said.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ring them together. Could you introduce it as a routine balance update? No need to replay the tears.
